title: Superhero Training Camp
description: Learn to save the day with a very grumpy teacher

fields.prompt: What is a silly describing word?
What would someone yell when they are surprised?

template:
Welcome to Superhero Training Camp! {name} arrived on the first day wearing a brand-new cape. The cape was {color}, and it flapped very dramatically even when there was no wind.

The instructor was the world's grumpiest {animal}, wearing a tiny helmet. "I am Captain Mustard," it said. "What is your superpower?"

"I have the power of {power}!" said {name}.

"Prove it," said Captain Mustard.

Just then, the alarm rang. The Evil {job} was stealing every {object} in town! "This is not a drill!" cried the Captain. "Go, go, go!"

{name} jumped onto the nearest {vehicle} and raced down the street. Everyone on the sidewalk looked up and shouted, "{exclaim}"

Soon {name} spotted the Evil {job} running away with a sack full of {object} and laughing like a goose. It was time to use the big power.

"{power}!" shouted {name}.

It went {noise}! Suddenly the {adj} Evil {job} tripped over a curb, dropped the sack, and rolled right into the town fountain.

But the sack was heavy. {name} had to {verb} all the way back to camp, with the cape flapping behind in the wind.

Captain Mustard was waiting at the gate. For a long time the {animal} said nothing.

Then it pinned a shiny medal on the {color} cape. "Not bad," it said. "You can be on my team. But you have to {verb} with the team every morning."

{name} was officially a superhero.
